resources.string: Pick a folder instead of typing it
When you start a session in another directory, tap Browse next to the path to walk through the server's folders. Your recent folders are one tap away.
In the New session sheet, a finger taps Browse, opens the projects folder and the mobile-app folder, then taps Use this folder to fill the path.
Open or stop running work in a tap
Tap a chip above the message box to see every running agent and shell in one list. Open jumps to the subagent's session, Stop ends it.
A finger taps the running agents chip, a list with agents and shells opens, Open goes to the agent's session and Stop agent removes it.
See the images your agent reads
When a tool reads a screenshot, a picture or a PDF, the file now shows right under the tool row. Tap an image to view it larger.
Two Read tool rows complete: the first shows an image preview under it, the second shows a PDF file chip.
Type /new for a fresh start
Type /new in the message box and pick the command: a new session opens at once in the same directory, without copying the old conversation.
The user types /new in the message box, taps the suggested command and the chat switches to an empty New session.
Connect AI providers from your phone
Open the provider list from the chat menu or type /connect. Paste an API key or sign in with a code: the credentials are saved on your server, not on your phone.
A finger taps OpenAI in the provider list, types an API key, taps Connect and OpenAI moves to the Connected group.
Jump to GitHub from any tool row
Tool rows that touch an issue, pull request, run or commit get a green Open action. Tap to open it on GitHub, long press to copy the link.
Three shell rows show green Open actions: Open #157, Open PR #156 and Open commit 4f2a9c1. Tapping opens the link, a long press copies it.
Running work, always in sight
Shells and subagents that are running appear as small chips above the message box. Tap one to see what is running and open its output. You can turn this off in Settings.
A shell chip and an agent chip appear above the message box; a finger taps the shell chip and a list with the running command opens.
Your model at a glance
The model button in the message box now shows the provider mark, a short name and the effort in a lighter color, like Haiku 5.5 Medium. Tap it to switch.
A finger taps the model button in the message box several times; it changes from Haiku 5.5 Medium to Opus 5.5 High, GPT-5.2 High and Gemini 3 Pro, each with its provider mark.
Stop everything with one tap
The Running sheet groups subagents and commands, each with a Stop all button. Every row also has its own Stop.
In the Running sheet, a finger taps Stop all on the Commands section, then on the Subagents section, and both lists empty.
Find a project in seconds
With many projects, the New session sheet has a search field. Type a few letters and every project that matches shows up, even the ones that were folded away.
A finger taps the search field in the New session sheet and types mob; the list narrows to mobile-app and mobile-kit.
Dress the app in a TUI theme
Choose any of the 33 OpenCode terminal themes in Settings, under Appearance, and the whole app takes its colors, including code and diffs.
A small chat is shown with four themes in turn: GitHub, Dracula, Gruvbox and Nord. A finger taps each theme dot and the colors change.
